GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-03-24T14:14:24Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Union type in JSX IntrinsicElements seems like a bug
Description: ```typescript
declare namespace JSX {
  interface IntrinsicElements {
    foo: { bar: boolean } | { baz: boolean };
  }
}

const one = <foo bar baz />; // ok
```

Hi. Is this a bug? I was expecting this to not compile but it does. 

In the IntrinsicElements interface the type for `foo` is defined as having a boolean attribute of `foo` **or** `baz` but it compiles when both are set.

I'm new to typescript so apologies if the issue is just my understanding of the type system.
